title: Ol' Fade Factory
description: Ol' Fade Factory — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Soldier Mutantos

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Slay 25 Shadow Fade Factory Workers and 5 Shadow Fade Factory Foremen in the Branches off of Lower Algor's Terror-Dome and Return to Ex-Soldier Bubba in Algor's Terror-Dome Base Camp.

Quest Reward: Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Soldier Mutantos

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Back To The Ol' Fade Factory

Zone: Algor's Terror Dome (Quest)

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Slay 25 Shadow Fade Factory Workers and 5 Shadow Fade Factory Foremen in the Branches off of Lower Algor's Terror-Dome and Return to Ex-Soldier Bubba in Algor's Terror-Dome Base Camp.

Offer:

This is most disturbing! Recently we shipped in some Shadow Fade into the branches off of Lower Algor's Terror-Dome as a cheap source of labor. These Shadow Fade are all prisoners who were to be put on a chain gang and charged with keeping the area clean, but something terrible has happened. Algor has somehow infiltrated their ranks and turned them to revolt. They are now setting up factories in the branches off of Lower Algor's Terror-Dome for the sole purpose of creating pollution.

There is nothing we can do now but beat down their working class until they can't effectively produce pollution. Head into the branches off of Lower Algor's Terror-Dome and slay the Shadow Fade Factory Workers and some of the Shadow Fade Factory Foremen. When you have done this return to me, Ex-Soldier Bubba, here in the Algor's Terror-Dome Base Camp.

Turn-in:

Good to see you. Your presence here must mean that the workforce in the Fade Factories has suffered some 'cutbacks'. Excellent! Well, let me know if you want to take part in some more layoffs.

Objectives:

  • Slain Shadow Fade Factory Worker
  • Slain Shadow Fade Factory Foremen

Client level range: 15–25
